unitTheme: Let's play sports! · 运动与球类
title: A Football Match
text: Last Sunday our class played football against Class Two. It was my first match, so I felt a little nervous. Our teacher told us to play as a team and not to be afraid. In the first half, we got one goal. In the second half, the other team played hard, but we did not give up. At last we won the match two to one. I was tired, yet I felt very happy. Football is not only about winning. It also teaches us to work together and never lose heart.

unitTheme: Welcome to our school! · 校园与学习生活
title: Welcome to Our New School
text: Our new school is not far from my home. It has eight floors and a big playground in front. On the first floor there is a reading room with thousands of books. Our classrooms are bright and clean, and every desk has a small bookshelf. There is also a computer room and a music room on the third floor. I like our new school best because I can learn a lot here. Our teachers are young and kind. We all feel happy in this building.

unitTheme: My day · 校园日常作息
title: My School Day
text: I get up at six every morning. After breakfast, I walk to school with my friend Lily. Classes begin at eight. We have four lessons in the morning and two in the afternoon. I like English and history best, but maths is difficult for me. After school, I often play basketball for half an hour. Then I do my homework and read for ten minutes before bed. A busy day makes me feel tired, but I never feel bored.

title: A Happy Mid-Autumn Festival
text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is an important festival in China. It comes in September or October. On that day, my family often sits together and eats mooncakes while we look at the bright moon. My grandma always tells us the story of Chang'e. Last year my parents came home early, and we made twenty mooncakes in the kitchen. My little brother wanted to eat them all, but my mother stopped him. We sent some to our neighbours, too. That night we all felt warm and happy.

unitTheme: Food and lifestyle · 健康饮食与生活方式
title: A Healthy Breakfast
text: Good food keeps us healthy. I have a simple breakfast every morning: an egg, a glass of milk and a small piece of bread. I also eat fruit after lunch. My grandmother used to give me chips and cola, but our doctor said they were not good for us. Now I drink water instead. I think a healthy lifestyle is not only about food. We should also do sports and go to bed early. If we take care of our body, we can study better.

title: Our School Fashion Show
text: Last month our school held a fashion show. Twenty students showed their own clothes. Tom made a coat out of old jeans. Sara wore a long dress made of cotton. I wore a white shirt and a pair of shorts that my mother sewed for me. We walked onto the stage to light music. The judges looked at our clothes and asked us questions. Tom's coat won the first prize because it was creative and cheap. I did not win, but I still felt proud of my clothes.

title: A Small but Warm Home
text: My home is small, but it is very warm. It is a two-bedroom flat on the fifth floor. My grandparents live with us, so our family has six people. There is a small balcony, and my grandma grows tomatoes and green beans there. My desk is under the window. Every evening the whole family sits there and talks about the day. We often argue about small things, but nobody is angry for long. Home is not about size. It is about the people inside it.

title: My Hometown
text: My hometown is a beautiful water city in east China. There are many small bridges over the rivers. In the early morning, boats carry fresh vegetables to the market. People here are friendly and they often say hello to strangers. The old town is famous for its stone streets and garden houses. My favourite place is a small park near the river, where I read books and watch boats. My hometown is changing fast, with new roads and tall buildings, but I still love its quiet streets.

unitTheme: Chinese folk art · 中国民间艺术
title: Paper Cutting
text: Paper cutting is an old Chinese folk art. My grandmother started learning it when she was young. Every winter she sits by the window and cuts red paper. She does not draw first. She folds the paper and cuts it with her small scissors. In a few minutes, a fish or a flower appears. People put these works on their windows before the Spring Festival. Last year our school asked her to show us how to cut a paper horse. She was happy, and so were we.

title: My Dog Doudou
text: My dog is called Doudou. He is two years old and white with black ears. He is not a big dog, but he is very strong. Every morning he runs with me in the park. After dinner, he waits by the door and looks at my shoes. If I put on my running shoes, he becomes wild with joy. Once I fell down on the road, and Doudou stayed beside me until my mother came. Dogs cannot speak, but they can understand our feelings.

title: A Morning by the Lake
text: The lake is only ten minutes' walk from my village. I go there with my father almost every weekend. We leave home before sunrise, so the sky is still grey and quiet. Soon the sun comes up behind the hills, and the water turns gold. Mist floats over the water like soft white cloth. Birds call in the reeds, and a small boat moves slowly across the lake. We sit on the bank, drink hot tea and say nothing. Such a morning makes me calm and free.

title: Camping in the Forest
text: Last summer our class had a two-day camping trip in the forest. We put up six tents in a clearing. It took us almost an hour. In the afternoon we made a fire and cooked noodles. The wind was strong, so we worked in teams. At night we sat around the fire and told stories. The sky was full of stars, and nobody wanted to sleep. In the morning, birds woke us up early. We cleaned the site and left no rubbish behind. It was the best trip of the year.

title: Birds in the Wetland
text: There is a wetland park near my home. About one hundred kinds of birds live there. Last Sunday my father and I took our binoculars and walked along the wood path. We did not feed them, either. Birdwatching needs only a pair of eyes, but it teaches us to be gentle with nature.

title: The Night of the Big Storm
text: A big storm hit our town one summer night. The wind broke a tree near our building, and the power went out at once. Our family sat by the windows and listened to the rain. My mother found a candle and put it on the table. Soon we heard someone outside shouting for help. An old man had fallen in the dark. My father and two neighbours carried him home and called a doctor. Nobody was hurt. The next morning the sun came out and the streets were full of fallen branches.

title: Helping the Community
text: Every Sunday a group of students comes to our community centre. We are all volunteers. Some of us teach old people how to use mobile phones. title: A Doctor Who Helps the World
text: Charities help people in many countries. Some collect money. Others send doctors and medicine. In one charity hospital, doctors from many countries work together. A young doctor from China went there for two years. He learned to work in a language that was not his own. He also taught local nurses new skills. Every weekend he joined a charity walk in the city, and many strangers gave money for free eye surgery. A small team can do great things when people work together.

title: Small Green Actions
text: A green life does not need big money. In our class, we turn off the lights when we leave a room. We use both sides of our paper. Our school sorts rubbish into different bins, and we put bottles in the right one. Last spring we planted twenty young trees along the road. Some of them grew well, but two died. Now we water them twice a week. A teacher said that a green habit is like a small seed. It grows quietly, and one day it becomes a tree.

unitTheme: Life on Mars · 火星生活与未来
title: A Day on Mars
text: Imagine living on Mars. The sky there is orange, and the air is thin, so people must wear special clothes. There is no rain, but robots collect ice from deep under the ground. In our town, houses are built half under the ground to keep cool. Students learn in a big hall, and they walk to school with small flying bikes. Food comes from greenhouses, so we still eat rice and vegetables. Life on Mars is hard, but it is not boring at all.
